proposals.before: Some impeached him for cruelty, but Governor-General Jiang Yinshen memorialized: "Tianjue loves the people as his own children and hates evil as his own enemy — he is an official in the ancient mold."
proposals.after: Some impeached him for cruelty, but Governor-General Jiang Youxian memorialized: "Tianjue loves the people as his own children and hates evil as his own enemy — he is an official in the ancient mold."
proposals.reason: Chinese 蔣攸銛 is Jiang Youxian; packet English wrongly renders Yinshen.

proposals.before: Some impeached him for cruelty; Governor-General Jiang Yinshen memorialized: "Tianjue loves the people as his children and hates evil as his enemy — he is an exemplary official of antiquity."
proposals.after: Some impeached him for cruelty; Governor-General Jiang Youxian memorialized: "Tianjue loves the people as his children and hates evil as his enemy — he is an exemplary official of antiquity."
proposals.reason: Chinese 蔣攸銛 is Jiang Youxian; literal English also has Jiang Yinshen.

decisions.reason: s0064 names the memorialist 總督蔣攸銛; 攸銛 is Youxian, not Yinshen. The idiomatic replacement corrects the misread name and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
The same focus phrase 蔣攸銛 is misrendered Jiang Yinshen in the literal field; Jiang Youxian restores the correct reading without other changes.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows alternate name Jiang Yinshen for 蔣攸銛 arose only from the mistranslation; s0064 supports Jiang Youxian (c0079), not a separate Yinshen alias.
